title: Birth date and birthplace
summary: Born October 24, 1902 near Columbus and St. Claude; he is unsure of details about Paul's age.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I don't believe you gave us your birth date exactly. And just what part of the city you were born in. I didn't want that. Right at the very beginning. Okay. I was born in New Orleans.
What part of town? Remember the street?
Let's see. I was... Liberty. St. Claude and... What's the street here? Columbus and St. Claude. Columbus and St. Claude.

Not far from here then. That's right. Your father lived there long. Did he live... Yeah, we lived there quite a while. Where was Paul? Born in the same place about... Had you lived there quite a while? Do you remember? I don't remember. I just can't remember. How much older is Paul than you? I forget.
Well, I'm 57. 57. I was... 362, I believe.
